## Section 4: Covenant Summary and Compliance

### 4.1 Proposed Financial Covenants

The draft Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated Sept 22, 2026 contains two financial ratio covenants and one capital expenditure covenant [D2, preamble; §7.1-§7.3].

Maximum Total Leverage Ratio: the Borrower "shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.25 to 1.00; provided that for each fiscal quarter ending on or after December 31, 2027, the maximum shall be 3.00 to 1.00" [D2, §7.1]. The Total Leverage Ratio is Total Funded Debt on the last day of a fiscal quarter divided by EBITDA for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended [D2, §1.1]. Total Funded Debt includes all indebtedness for borrowed money, all capital lease obligations, and the Equipment Notes [D2, §1.1].

Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio: the Borrower "shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.00 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter" [D2, §7.2]. The ratio is (a) EBITDA minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures minus cash taxes paid, divided by (b) scheduled payments of principal and interest on Total Funded Debt, for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended [D2, §1.1].

Capital Expenditures: "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures shall not exceed $2,500,000 in any fiscal year; provided that capital expenditures for the Expansion Project, not exceeding $6,000,000 in the aggregate, shall be excluded" [D2, §7.3]. "Expansion Project" is defined in Schedule 1.1, which is not in the excerpt [D2, §1.1].

### 4.2 Proposed Reporting Covenants

The Borrower must deliver annual consolidated financial statements, audited by an independent accounting firm acceptable to the Lender, within 120 days after each fiscal year-end [D2, §7.4(a)]. Internally prepared quarterly consolidated financial statements are due within 45 days after each fiscal quarter [D2, §7.4(b)]. Each quarterly delivery must include a Compliance Certificate signed by a financial officer, showing the §7.1 and §7.2 calculations for the period [D2, §7.4(c)].

### 4.3 Proposed Negative Covenants and Default Trigger

Negative pledge: the Borrower "shall not create, incur or permit to exist any Lien on any of its assets, except Permitted Liens" [D2, §7.5(a)]. Permitted Liens are (i) Liens in favor of the Lender; (ii) Liens securing the Equipment Notes, limited to the equipment financed by those notes; (iii) purchase-money Liens securing indebtedness in an aggregate amount not exceeding $1,000,000 at any time outstanding; and (iv) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable [D2, §7.5(b)]. The Equipment Notes are promissory notes issued to Prairie Equipment Finance, secured by the equipment they finance [D2, §1.1]. Pro forma Equipment Notes are 11,000 [D1, §3 note; §4].

Change of Control: "It shall be an Event of Default if the Founders cease to own, directly or indirectly, a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests of the Borrower, or cease to be actively involved in the management of the Borrower" [D2, §7.6].
